title: Tiger Mask vs. Dynamite Kid
summary: The original Tiger Mask must prove that an animated hero can become a credible wrestling star. Dynamite Kid’s aggression and technique provide the ideal test for a new junior-heavyweight style.

chapters.title: Tiger Mask’s debut victory
chapters.result: Tiger Mask defeats Dynamite Kid in his debut under the mask.
chapters.context: Satoru Sayama introduces the character through a demanding match, establishing athletic credibility alongside its comic-book identity.

chapters.title: The rivalry brings championship gold
chapters.result: Tiger Mask defeats Dynamite Kid for the WWF junior heavyweight title.
chapters.context: The returning opponents turn their rivalry into a championship breakthrough for the masked star. This was the historical WWF junior title contested in Japan.
